POL-GEN-03 reads an outcome against the filing party, so the ruling that leaves the rider not carrying the charge is NO_ACTION, which lets the present state stand; DRIVER_COMPENSATION would put the same SGD 5.00 back onto a rider for a trip she never took. The rider's relief is therefore NO_ACTION and not a refund order, because POL-GEN-03 defines the refund values against the filing party and the filer here is the driver.

The clause tests placing, not answering or receipt, so the contact obligation is met here and the fee cannot be voided on that limb.

No repeat no-show referral can attach to this rider on this trip: her profile snapshot carries no no_show_cancellations_30d field at all, and POL-NS-25 operates only where that optional counter is present, so nothing on this record supports flagging her account for mandatory upfront payment or temporary suspension whatever becomes of the fee.

The rider's counter-statement that 'He never called me, he only sent messages' is contradicted by the platform's own record: the chat log carries an outgoing in-app call entry at 13:30:15, before cancellation. POL-NS-23 treats such an entry as satisfying the call limb, and the chat log is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so the rider's account cannot support voiding the fee.

The driver's arrival at the pickup is corroborated under POL-NS-21. The GPS trace's nearest fix to the pickup lies 0.497 m away at 13:27:10, with a reported horizontal accuracy of 6 m, inside the 25 m gps_accuracy_filter_m and well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius; derived.arrival reports corroborated = true and accuracy_reported = true. The arrival event at 13:27:15 is therefore established on the trace, not merely asserted.

The free wait was served. This is an on-demand trip with no scheduled_at, so under POL-NS-21 the 300 s free wait ran from the driver's arrival at 13:27:15 and ended at 13:32:15; the driver cancelled at 13:33:40, 385 s after arrival and 85 s after the free wait expired. The driver was entitled to cancel for rider no-show.

POL-NS-24's driver-no-show branch is not engaged. The trip is on-demand and carries no scheduled pickup time, the driver arrived at the pickup at 13:27:15 within about seven minutes of the 13:20:20 booking, and the driver then waited beyond the free wait before cancelling: the 13:20:40 'wait_timer_expired' event at 13:32:20 confirms the rider was not on board when the wait ran out. No FULL_REFUND is due on this clause.

Because the driver cancelled after the free wait, POL-NS-22 applies: the 5.00 SGD no-show fee is charged to the rider and transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel. The fare breakdown confirms fee_charged_sgd 5.00, policy_fee_sgd 5.00, driver_compensation_if_upheld_sgd 5.00 and fee_matches_policy true, so the fee is due to the driver at that figure.

NO_ACTION is not a driver win on this record. The driver is the filer and the ledger already shows payment_status REFUNDED with refund_issued_sgd 5.0 — the 5.00 SGD was refunded to the rider and withheld from the driver at 15:25:40 pending review. Under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION outcome leaves that present state standing, which would leave the driver unpaid; the only outcome that moves the money to the driver is DRIVER_COMPENSATION of 5.00 SGD.

Escalation is not warranted under POL-GEN-26. Every fact the no-show rules need — the arrival at the pickup, the message and the call before cancellation, and the 385 s from arrival to cancellation — is carried by COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0, so no material fact is left unestablished and there is no open question to send to a human reviewer.

The AI may decide this case finally. The amount contested is 5.00 SGD, below POL-GEN-22's 10.00 SGD first band, where the AI ruling is final at any confidence, and neither profile carries a fraud flag (rider 0, driver 0), so no 0.95 fraud bar is raised and no human-review referral is triggered.

The one absent artifact does not touch the driver's case. EV-ADVIS-05069-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. A traffic advisory supplies no fact the POL-NS-21/22/23 no-show test uses, so its absence neither opens a question under POL-GEN-26 nor weakens the contact, arrival or free-wait findings, all of which rest on present, COMPLETE artifacts.

Driver D-20229, your claim succeeds. Rider R-61596, the SGD 5.00 no-show fee is payable to the driver; the record does not support voiding it.

Arrival and free wait (POL-NS-21). The trip was on-demand with no scheduled pickup time, so the 5-minute (300 s) free wait ran from the driver's arrival. The wait expired at 13:32:15 and the driver cancelled at 13:33:40, 385 s after arrival and 85 s after the wait ran out. POL-NS-21's condition is met.

Contact obligation (POL-NS-23). The clause requires a message and a call to be placed, accepts a voice-call entry in the chat log as proof of the call, and tests placing, not answering. Rider, your account that 'he never called me, he only sent messages' is answered: the platform's own chat log records the outgoing call; it was placed, it was not answered, and the clause reads the log as its test.

Fee (POL-NS-22). The fare breakdown shows a 5.00 SGD no-show fee, matching the policy fee of 5.00 SGD (fee_matches_policy true, fee_charged_sgd 5.00, driver_compensation_if_upheld_sgd 5.00). POL-NS-22 applies: where the fee stands, the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with both amount fields equal to the fee charged — 5.00 SGD.

Why not NO_ACTION. Rider, it was argued that because the SGD 5.00 was already refunded to you at 15:25:40 (payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 5.00), the present state should simply stand. POL-GEN-03 defines NO_ACTION as the filing party's claim not being supported — and the filing party here is the driver, whose claim the record supports. The interim reversal was a hold pending review, not a finding; the no-show conditions are met, so the fee is due. NO_ACTION would leave the driver unpaid on a fee that is owed, and POL-GEN-03 says NO_ACTION never means 'restore a charge'. The SGD 5.00 moves to the driver as DRIVER_COMPENSATION.

No escalation. There is no open question under POL-GEN-26: every fact the no-show rules need — arrival, contact before cancellation, and the elapsed free wait — is carried by COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0. The one absent artifact, traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-05069-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0), supplies no fact these clauses use. No repeat-no-show referral applies (POL-NS-25): the rider's profile carries no 30-day no-show counter. No fee-amount referral applies (POL-NS-22): the fee charged is exactly 5.00 SGD. No goodwill credit arises (POL-NS-24): the driver arrived and attempted contact. On POL-GEN-01/POL-GEN-22, no profile history is used against either party, and neither profile carries a fraud flag.

Decision: DRIVER_COMPENSATION of 5.00 SGD to driver D-20229 (amount_sgd and driver_compensation_sgd both 5.00). Confidence 0.95. The dispute is below 10.00 SGD, neither profile carries a fraud flag, and POL-NS-26 makes the AI ruling final.
